# Calebros

> Nosferatu Prince Pro Tempore of New York since the Camarilla victory of 1999. He took the job because nobody else was trusted, and he has been trying to give it back ever since.

## Appearance

Like every Nosferatu, Calebros is a ruin to look at: hunched, grey, with a face that children would draw to frighten each other. He wears good suits anyway, and keeps them clean, which the court finds oddly moving.

## Personality

Tired, careful, honest by the standards of Princes. Calebros rules by paperwork and quiet conversations rather than by fear. He is a caretaker and says so: the title Prince Pro Tempore was his own choice of words, and he has never once called himself Prince without the qualifier.

## Role in Campaign 1

- Holds court in the old control room of the Fenwick Street pumping station.
- Has asked the Primogen to settle his succession by vote. Privately he expects knives.
- Knows that the lower tunnels are wrong. Closed the deep stairs in the spring. Has not told the Primogen why.
- Will treat a sensible neonate as a potential pair of eyes; the Prince Pro Tempore needs people nobody watches.

## Stats (summary)

Eighth generation Nosferatu; trait maximum 5, blood pool 15, spends up to 3 blood per turn. Obfuscate 5, Animalism 4, Potence 3, Fortitude 2. Willpower 8, Humanity 7. Avoids fights; wins them anyway, through rats and patience.
